candidates.topic: Full Moon in Taurus — Five Planets Retrograde Collision
candidates.teaser: Tonight's Full Moon is pulling in five retrograde planets at once — and astrologers say this one is different.
candidates.video_title: Full Moon in Taurus — 5 Retrogrades Hit at Once
candidates.video_description: The Full Moon in Taurus on October 27 opposes the Scorpio Sun while five planets are simultaneously retrograde. Astrologers interpret this as a rare pressure point between what you value and what you're being asked to release.
candidates.script: Five planets are retrograde right now — and tonight they all collide with the Full Moon. The Moon is sitting at 26° Taurus, directly opposite the Scorpio Sun, pulling every unresolved thing you've been avoiding straight to the surface. Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are all moving backwards while this lunation peaks. In astrology, a Full Moon under this much retrograde pressure is read as a reckoning — not a celebration. What have you been refusing to feel?

candidates.topic: Mercury Retrograde in Scorpio — Now Active, What It's Targeting
candidates.teaser: Mercury retrograde in Scorpio just started — and it's not going after your emails, it's going after your secrets.
candidates.video_title: Mercury Retrograde in Scorpio — It's Not What You Think
candidates.video_description: Mercury stationed retrograde in Scorpio on October 27 and stays there until November 13. Unlike typical Mercury retrogrades, this one falls in Scorpio — the sign of secrets, psychology, and hidden power dynamics.
candidates.script: Mercury retrograde isn't what you think — not this time. It stationed retrograde today at 20° Scorpio, and it stays there until November 13th. Most Mercury retrogrades mess with your schedule. Scorpio sends it somewhere deeper: buried conversations, old betrayals, things you said you were over. In astrology, Mercury in Scorpio already digs for truth — retrograde makes it obsessive. Expect something you thought was resolved to resurface before this window closes. Which relationship comes to mind right now?

candidates.topic: Venus Retrograde in Libra — Final Degrees Tension
candidates.teaser: Venus is retrograde at 28° Libra right now — and that degree alone tells astrologers something urgent is ending.
candidates.video_title: Venus Retrograde at 28° Libra — Something Is Ending
candidates.video_description: Venus is currently retrograde at 28°Libra — just two degrees from the sign's final edge. In astrology, late degrees of any sign carry intensified, urgent energy. Combined with retrograde motion, this placement is read as a last chance to resolve something in love or values.
candidates.script: Venus retrograde at 28° Libra is one of the most tension-loaded placements in astrology right now. The 28th degree sits two steps from the edge — astrologers call late degrees a crisis point, where a sign's themes become urgent and unavoidable. Venus rules love and what we value, Libra rules balance and partnership, and retrograde reverses direction. Something in your closest relationships is being reviewed for the last time before this chapter closes. Are you honest about what you actually want?

candidates.topic: Scorpio Season — Sun at 4° Scorpio, What the Sign Actually Rules
candidates.teaser: Everyone thinks Scorpio is about intensity and mystery — but astrologers say that's only half the story.
candidates.video_title: What Scorpio Season Is Actually About
candidates.video_description: The Sun is at 4° Scorpio, making this the heart of Scorpio season. Beyond the popular 'dark and mysterious' reputation, Scorpio in traditional astrology rules transformation, shared resources, death and rebirth cycles, and psychological power.
candidates.script: Scorpio's reputation is intensity and mystery — but astrologers say that's the surface level read. The Sun is at 4° Scorpio right now, and what this sign actually governs runs much deeper: shared resources, power dynamics, psychological transformation, and the things we inherit from others — debt, trauma, money, secrets. Scorpio isn't dark for the sake of it. In traditional astrology, it rules the process of dying to one version of yourself so another can exist. What version of you is currently dissolving?

candidates.topic: The 12th House — Astrology's Most Misunderstood House
candidates.teaser: If you have planets in your 12th house, most astrology content has been telling you the wrong thing about them.
candidates.video_title: The 12th House — Astrology Got It Wrong
candidates.video_description: The 12th house is traditionally called the house of hidden enemies, self-undoing, and isolation — which sounds terrifying. But modern and traditional astrologers increasingly interpret it as the house of unconscious strength, spiritual depth, and what operates beneath the surface of your personality.
candidates.script: If you have planets in your 12th house, you've probably been told they're hidden, weakened, or working against you. Traditional astrology called it the house of self-undoing and hidden enemies — which is accurate, but massively incomplete. The 12th house is where your chart operates below the surface: unconscious patterns, spiritual sensitivity, things you sense before you understand them. Planets here aren't lost — they're just not performing for the crowd. Do you know what's in your 12th?
